items.source: Convenience method to allow adding a Streamable directly as otherwise the invocation is ambiguous between Streamable.and(Iterable) and Streamable.and(Supplier).
items.translation: 提供便捷方法，允许直接添加一个Streamable，否则调用会在Streamable.and(Iterable)和Streamable.and(Supplier)之间产生歧义。

items.source: Returns a new Streamable that will apply the given Function to the current one.

items.translation: 自定义Page以承载从GeoResults检索到的平均距离，GeoPage即由此构建。

items.source: Class to parse a String into a tree or PartTree.OrParts consisting of simple Part instances in turn.
items.translation: 用于解析 `String` 为树或 PartTree.OrPart 的类，这些树或 PartTree.OrPart 由简单的 Part 实例组成。

items.source: Returns all Parts of the PartTree of the given Part.Type.
items.translation: 返回给定Part.Type的PartTree的所有Part。

items.source: A collector to easily produce a Streamable from a Stream using Collectors.toList() as intermediate collector.
items.translation: 一个收集器，能够利用 Collectors.toList() 作为中间收集器，从 Stream 轻松生成一个 Streamable。

items.source: Simple wrapper class for a List of Revisions allowing to canonically access the latest revision.
items.translation: 一个用于封装 List 的简单包装类，该列表包含 Revisions 对象，允许规范地访问最新修订版本。

items.source: Value object to access PersistentEntity instances managed by MappingContexts.
items.translation: 用于访问由MappingContext管理的PersistentEntity实例的值对象。

items.source: Returns all TypeInformation exposed by the registered MappingContexts.
items.translation: 返回所有已注册的MappingContext所暴露的TypeInformation。

items.source: Descriptor for a property-level type along its potential projection that is held within a Collection-like or Map-like container.
items.translation: 描述属性级类型在其潜在投影中的描述符，该类型被持有在类似 Collection 或类似 Map 的容器中。

items.source: Returns an Iterable of all parts contained in the PartTree.
items.translation: 返回一个包含 PartTree 中所有部分的Iterable。

items.source: Creates a new Streamable from the current one and the given Stream concatenated.
items.translation: 从当前对象和给定的 Stream 创建一个由它们拼接而成的新 Streamable。

items.source: Returns a new Streamable that will apply the given filter Predicate to the current one.
items.translation: 返回一个新的Streamable，该对象将把给定的过滤条件Predicate应用于当前对象。

items.source: Returns a Streamable for the given Iterable.
items.translation: 返回给定Iterable的Streamable。

items.source: A collector to easily produce a Streamable from a Stream and the given intermediate collector.

items.source: Central domain abstractions especially to be used in combination with the Repository abstraction.
